板块：资金避险情绪升温，防守类及能源板块逆市造好。受惠于油价走强预期，石油股成资金避风港，西方石油(OXY)升3.56%，雪佛龙(CVX)及埃克森美孚(XOM)分别升3.12%及2.71%。零售家装巨头亦见发力，劳氏(LOW)及家得宝(HD)分别涨4.03%及3.39%。另一边厢，半导体及光通讯板块沦为重灾区，做空半导体的ETF(SOXS)急飙10.24%，反映芯片股抛售尤为惨烈，领跌个股中安谋(ARM)重挫6.48%，光通讯设备商高意(COHR)及应用光电(AAOI)更分别急泻9.63%及13.58%。大市转弱亦令做空纳指的ETF(SQQQ)录得4.13%升幅。

焦点：大行早前曾唱好科技股季绩将大面积超预期，惟宏观无风险利率高企令市场对高估值的容错率极低，导致资金趁高获利。新晋AI题材渐露疲态，有获巨头背书的AI初创IPO认购惨淡，反映机构资金对纯算力概念转趋审慎。政策层面，市场传出华府或收紧科技大厂外籍工程师的绿卡项目，引发外界对底层研发迭代受阻的忧虑。然而，部分软件及老牌科技股相对抗跌，奥多比(ADBE)及雪花(SNOW)分别逆市上扬3.56%及3.17%，国际商业机器(IBM)亦靠稳，全日收升2.77%。

小结：分析指，近期云端巨头频频斥资锁定核电资源，由轻资产模式转向重基建，加上企业端AI降本增效的红利仍需高昂的云服务开支来支撑，相关成本正促使市场重新审视AI供应链的盈利模型。随着纳指受压且科网股沽压未止，大市风格或正经历新旧经济股的轮动切换。后市需密切留意无风险利率走势，以及龙头科技股接下来的业绩指引能否提供支撑，料短期内美股走势仍以反复震荡寻底为主。

最近看各家大厂都在疯狂吹自家的Agent，画饼说以后能帮用户全自动买机票、找折扣。我觉得这帮人没安好心。

author: Balder13946731
text:
Everyone's waiting to see AI turn up in the electricity bill. It'll turn up in the price of a laptop first.

An HBM bit eats roughly three times the wafer capacity of a plain DRAM bit, and Hynix and Samsung have spent two years converting lines over to make them, so commodity DRAM supply has been shrinking right into the best demand year memory has ever had. You haven't felt it because PCs and phones buy on contract — that repricing lands a couple of quarters late, inside somebody's gross margin. Dell's, for one. Memory is a real chunk of the BOM there, the operating margin is mid single digits, and the guy outbidding them for the same wafer is financing his cluster with money that doesn't care what it costs. There isn't much of a negotiation in that.

Cleanest money in AI is still memory. Hynix helped build this shortage and is selling into it.

Not all neoclouds are created the same way not all neocloud capacity is worth the same, and this chart shows it.

Every gigawatt Nebius signs away in a long-term hosting deal brings in roughly $20-25B. 

The same gigawatt sold short-term on its own platform brings in $40-50B. Same power, same data center, about double the revenue.

Serverless inference is the purest version of that. 

Instead of renting a cluster for five years, customers pay per token for exactly what they use, while Nebius runs the hardware, the software and the optimization in between.

Why I think it's the next big leg for 
$NBIS
:

+ Training is lumpy and driven by a few giant customers. Inference is every company shipping an AI product, every single day.
+ Usage-based pricing scales with adoption. More agents means more tokens, which means more revenue from the same gigawatt.
+ The software is the moat. Uptime guarantees, speculative decoding and auto-scaling are hard to copy for someone who's just renting out racks.
+ It spreads revenue across thousands of customers instead of a couple of hyperscalers.

The big contracts pay for the build but inference is where the money is.

Bet on the companies that are pushing for more server-less inference.

For me, that’s 
$NBIS
